title: Karbal Ye Tere Ban Me Kiska Ye Ghar Loota Hai
body:
Karbal ye tere ban me kiska ye ghar loota hai.
1. Barchi ko bhagaya hai aththara saal wala.
Ek teer ko mila hai asgher sa bholabhala.
Abbas ke alam par darya ne haat daala.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Akbar ki laash leke sooti hai noujawani.
Mitti may chupgayi hai asgher ki be zubaani.
Sajde se shai ne likhdi islam ki kahani.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dulha bana huwa hai wo laadla hasan ka.
Baraat sunrahi hai nouha nayi dulhan ka.
Lo gul ye kaam aaya zehra tere chaman ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Moula Ali ki beti be parda jaarahi hai.
Sabre Hussain lekar qutbe sunarahi hai.
Abbas ke alam se awaaz aarahi hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bhai ki laash par hai Zainab behan ke naala
Yeh tou batao ab tou ab koun hai hamara.
Jaate hai Karbala se hafiz quda tumhara.
